gap._description: Confirmed missing emissions (probe-verified against the real WASM)

gaps.missing: imports kind misclassified usage_contextual instead of import_based — the tier classifier has no 'imports' branch (the TS T1 / JVM K8 finding): every ES6/require/re-export dependency edge falls to usage_contextual
gaps.evidence: probe: import def from './m' -> imports: probe -> ./m:def conf=1 evidenceClass=usage_contextual (expect import_based)
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (javascript/import-edges) + mutants javascript/reclassify-import-tier + javascript/drop-import-edges CAUGHT (2026-08-27). The dedicated 'imports' kind now classifies as import_based (classifier imports branch added), matching TS T1 / JVM K8.

gaps.missing: dynamic import('./lazy') emits a spurious calls -> import edge and NO imports edge for the module — TS7 was closed in the TS wave; the JS dynamic-import fixture currently documents the bug as accepted
gaps.evidence: probe: const lazy = import('./lazy') -> calls: probe -> import (spurious); no imports edge for ./lazy
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (javascript/dynamic-import) + mutants javascript/drop-import-edges + javascript/reclassify-import-tier CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Dynamic import() now emits an imports edge (module:*) and the spurious calls -> import edge is suppressed (the `import` keyword lexes as its own node type — the TS T7 quirk).

gaps.missing: string interpolation `${x}` emits no Uses on the interpolated identifiers (TS3 T3 / kotlin K4 / scala G4 analog)
gaps.evidence: probe: const s = `hi ${n} x` inside method -> no uses edge on n
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (javascript/interp-uses) + mutant javascript/drop-template-uses CAUGHT (2026-08-27). template_substitution identifiers now emit Uses (isTemplateInterpolation), matching TS T3 / kotlin K4 / scala G4.

gaps.missing: obj.method() emits BOTH calls (obj.method -> method) AND uses (obj -> method, isFieldAccess) — the family contract (TS/kotlin/scala) skips the callee in uses because calls covers it; JS double-emits
gaps.evidence: probe: obj.method() -> calls: method -> method AND uses: obj -> method
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (javascript/callee-uses) + mutant javascript/reintroduce-callee-uses CAUGHT (2026-08-27). A member_expression in call-callee position emits the Calls edge only — no double uses edge (family contract; web-tree-sitter wrappers compared by id, never reference).

gaps.missing: calls inside static { } blocks attribute to the MODULE, not the enclosing class — kotlin K7 init-attribution analog
gaps.evidence: probe: class A { static { initStatic(); } } -> calls: probe-js1 -> initStatic (expect A)
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (javascript/static-block) + mutant javascript/drop-static-calls CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Calls inside static { } blocks and static field initializers attribute to the enclosing class (kotlin K7 analog).

gaps.missing: top-level const r = x instanceof T attributes the reference to 'global' instead of r — the resolveSource walk lacks variable_declarator (TS fixed this in the same wave)
gaps.evidence: probe: const r = obj instanceof TopLevel -> references: global -> TopLevel (expect r)
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (javascript/instanceof-source) + mutant javascript/global-instanceof-source CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Top-level const r = x instanceof T attributes the reference to r, not the global placeholder (resolveSource gained variable_declarator).

gaps.missing: module-level destructured bindings (const { a } = obj / const [b] = arr) emit NO symbols — TS emits them as constants (probe-verified parity gap)
gaps.evidence: probe: const { d2 } = someObj -> no symbol; TS same shape -> a [constant]
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (javascript/destructure-symbols) + mutant javascript/drop-destructure-symbols CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Module-level destructured bindings (object patterns: shorthand/nested/default/renamed; array patterns: head/rest) now emit symbols, matching TS.

gaps.missing: JSX component usage emits NOTHING — <Button/> produces no edges. JSX is native to the JS grammar (8 types in the gate enumeration), unlike TS where it is a separate tsx dialect; the analyzer's detectsJsx only sets a pattern flag
gaps.evidence:
probe: const App = () =>
-> no uses/instantiates edges for Button
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (javascript/jsx-usage) + mutant javascript/drop-jsx-uses CAUGHT (2026-08-27). JSX is native to the JS grammar — capitalized components now emit Uses with jsxElement metadata; lowercase intrinsics stay silent (TS family contract).

decisions.question: typeParameters payload: JavaScript has NO generics — the grammar declares no type_parameters node. Recommend: DECLARED N/A (omit from the payload matrix), consistent with the family contract that payloads exist only where the language declares them.
decisions.resolution: RULED — DECLARED N/A (2026-08-27): JavaScript has no generics — the grammar declares no type_parameters node; the typeParameters payload row is omitted from the Matrix (family contract: payloads exist only where the language declares them).

decisions.question: apiContract payload: JS has no framework API-contract concept (TS's api-contract is typed). Recommend: DECLARED N/A (groovy also omits it).
decisions.resolution: RULED — DECLARED N/A (2026-08-27): JavaScript has no framework API-contract concept (TS's api-contract is typed); the apiContract payload row is omitted (groovy also omits it).

decisions.question: [key]: value computed names are recursed generically with no dedicated symbol — recommend INTERNAL SILENT (TS D6 consistency).
decisions.resolution: RULED — INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): computed_property_name [key]: value is recursed generically with no dedicated symbol (TS D6 consistency).

decisions.question: Glimmer/Ember templates are declared by the grammar but ignored — recommend INTERNAL SILENT (TS D4 consistency).
decisions.resolution: RULED — INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): Glimmer/Ember templates are declared by the grammar but ignored by the analyzer (TS D4 consistency).

decisions.question: class static blocks: the block is recursed (calls found) but attribution lands on the module — J5 covers the attribution fix; the block structure itself is handled.
decisions.resolution: RULED — HANDLED (2026-08-27): class_static_block structure is recursed; the attribution fix is J5 (calls now land on the enclosing class).

decisions.question: AnalyzeContext.overrideCompanion is never populated by production callers — what must the analyzer do for externally-declared bases?
decisions.resolution: M37.10 ruling (family-wide): the companion is optional enrichment, never a hard gate. In-file base declaring the method -> verified override @0.95; companion present -> companion-index resolution; otherwise deterministic Pass-3 first-parent guess @0.5 with reasonCode 'first-parent-guess' and tier 'inferred' — below the patterns.ts 0.7 threshold, counted as heuristic by the F5 differential. Gating on the companion alone silently dropped every cross-file override. Gated by F9-PROBE-M3710-JAVASCRIPT, the javascript/external-override fixture + confidence pins, and 6 family regression mutants.
